rejectedSheet.en: If an autistic person goes to an emergency department, it helps to ask them directly about suicidal thoughts, even when the stated reason for the visit is something else. Noticing life changes or conflicts with other people can also help. This was an exploratory review of charts of 16 autistic adults seen at a psychiatric emergency department over 10 weeks. Suicidal thoughts were not always the reason for the visit, and ruminating on them was distressing and tiring. The sample is very small and is not a rule for every person. If you are worried about someone, seek professional help: a clinician, a health service or a crisis service. In immediate danger, call your country's emergency number.

rejectedSheet.en: If you support an autistic person, it helps to ask calmly and without judgment how they are feeling, and to take any sign of distress, self-harm or thoughts of suicide seriously. This systematic review and meta-analysis pooled 31 observational studies of children and adults. It found higher odds of self-injury (pooled OR 3.18) and suicidality (pooled OR 3.32) in autistic people, in both clinical and nonclinical settings. These are associations: they cannot say what will happen for one person or explain causes. If you are worried about someone, seek professional help (a clinician, a health service or a crisis service). In immediate danger, call your country's emergency number.

rejectedSheet.en: If you care for an autistic person in Italy, keeping a simple record of caregiving hours, days off work or school, and what you pay for each service can help when you talk with the school, social services or a support group. Carers spent on average 58.84 ± 48.36 hours a week on caregiving, and many paid psychologists and therapists themselves. Its limits: the reports come from carers, not from autistic people themselves, and cover only Italy, so they do not describe every family or every situation.

rejectedSheet.en: If you wonder whether a probiotic would change daily life, this study is not enough to decide. The authors report improvements on a behaviour scale, in body and object use, and in digestive symptoms. However, the group is small, the abstract is incomplete, and the scales capture what adults observe, not what the child experiences. It tested a supplement, so any health or treatment decision belongs with a clinician.

Reducir esa presión puede ayudar. Es un estudio con encuesta en línea, diseñada junto a personas autistas; sus respuestas abiertas de 277 adultos autistas se analizaron por temas. Pasar mucho tiempo camuflándose parecía lo más dañino para la salud mental, aunque el camuflaje también daba acceso a espacios sociales y protección. rejectedSheet.en: If you support an autistic adult, you can calmly ask how much time they feel they must hide their natural way of being, and which places or people let them stop. Reducing that pressure may help. This was an online survey designed with autistic adults; the open answers of 277 autistic adults were analysed by theme. Spending a lot of time camouflaging seemed most damaging to mental health, though camouflaging also gave access to social spaces and protection from harm. It reflects people's own experiences and does not apply to everyone. The survey also asked about self-injury and suicidal thoughts. If distress is intense, seek professional help from a clinician, a health service or a crisis service. In immediate danger, call your country's emergency number.

rejectedSheet.en: If you are wondering about vitamin D before, during or after pregnancy, or in childhood, ask a paediatrician or midwife whether checking levels makes sense; decisions about supplements belong to a health professional. This is a review of the literature on vitamin D, pregnancy and childhood, which mentions possible links with pregnancy complications, bone health, respiratory infections and autism. Its limits: the abstract does not say how many studies were included, and it describes possible relationships, not proven causes. It does not mean a deficiency explains any autistic person's autism, or that anyone did something wrong.

Detta är en översikt av litteraturen om D-vitamin, graviditet och barndom, som nämner möjliga samband med graviditetskomplikationer, skelettets hälsa, luftvägsinfektioner och autism. Begränsningar: sammanfattningen anger inte hur många studier som ingår och beskriver möjliga samband, inte bevisade orsaker. rejectedSheet.en: Ask autistic adults in midlife or older age, calmly and without judgement, how they are doing, including any thoughts of harming themselves; asking does not cause these thoughts. This study had 388 people aged 40-93 years, 222 of them autistic, who completed questionnaires. Autistic people reported more suicidal thoughts and self-harm than non-autistic people, especially women and older people. The data are self-reported, from one point in time and a convenience sample, so they do not describe everyone. If you or someone close is thinking of self-harm, contact a clinician, health service or crisis service; in immediate danger, call the emergency number of your country.
rejectedSheet.sv: Fråga lugnt och utan att döma autistiska vuxna i medelåldern eller högre ålder hur de mår, även om tankar på att skada sig själva; att fråga väcker inte sådana tankar. De autistiska personerna rapporterade fler självmordstankar och mer självskadande än icke-autistiska, särskilt kvinnor och äldre. Uppgifterna är självrapporterade, från en enda tidpunkt och ett bekvämlighetsurval, så de beskriver inte alla. rejectedSheet.es: Si le preocupa el ácido fólico, hable con un profesional sanitario antes de cambiar nada; esta revisión no ofrece una pauta para decidir en casa. Es una revisión sistemática de estudios sobre ácido fólico y autismo. Algunos estudios señalan un posible efecto beneficioso de la suplementación materna prenatal (600 µg) sobre la probabilidad de autismo, pero otros dieron resultados opuestos. Se trata de un tema médico, y las decisiones médicas corresponden a un clínico. Sus límites: los autores piden ensayos más claros, con más participantes y más seguimiento, así que no permite conclusiones firmes para ninguna persona.
rejectedSheet.en: If folic acid is on your mind, talk with a health professional before changing anything; this review gives no guidance for deciding at home. It is a systematic review of studies on folic acid and autism. Some studies point to a possible benefit of prenatal maternal supplementation (600 µg) on the likelihood of autism, but others found opposite results. This is a medical topic, and medical decisions belong to a clinician. Its limits: the authors call for clearer trials with more participants and longer follow-up, so it cannot support firm conclusions for any one person.
rejectedSheet.sv: Om folsyra oroar dig, prata med en vårdgivare innan du ändrar något; den här översikten ger ingen vägledning för beslut hemma. Det är en systematisk översikt av studier om folsyra och autism. Vissa studier tyder på en möjlig fördel med tillskott till modern under graviditeten (600 µg) för sannolikheten för autism, men andra visade motsatta resultat. Detta är ett medicinskt ämne, och medicinska beslut hör till en läkare. Begränsningar: författarna efterlyser tydligare studier med fler deltagare och längre uppföljning, så översikten ger inga säkra slutsatser för någon enskild person.

rejectedSheet.es: Si le ofrecen una intervención para reducir una conducta, pregunte por qué esa conducta es el objetivo y para quién es un problema. No es lo mismo una conducta dañina, como la autolesión, que un movimiento repetitivo que no causa daño. Esta es una revisión sistemática de 102 estudios de intervenciones no farmacológicas con niños autistas de hasta ocho años. Solo el 8% ofreció una definición conceptual de la conducta que buscaba reducir, y la mayoría usó informes de los padres. Es un análisis de cómo investigan, no de qué funciona, y no vale igual para cada persona. Si le preocupa la autolesión, hable con un profesional de salud o un servicio de crisis; ante un peligro inmediato, llame al número de emergencias de su país.
rejectedSheet.en: If you are offered an intervention to reduce a behavior, ask why that behavior is the target and who it is a problem for. Behavior that causes harm, such as self-injury, is not the same as a harmless repetitive movement. This is a systematic review of 102 nonpharmacological intervention studies with autistic children up to age eight. Only 8% offered a conceptual definition of the behavior they aimed to reduce, and most relied on parent reports. It examines how researchers study this, not what works, and it does not apply equally to every person. If you are worried about self-injury, contact a clinician, a health service or a crisis service; in immediate danger, call the emergency number of your country.

Ett beteende som skadar, som självskada, är inte detsamma som en ofarlig repetitiv rörelse. Detta är en systematisk översikt av 102 studier av icke-farmakologiska insatser för autistiska barn upp till åtta år. Bara 8% gav en begreppslig definition av beteendet de ville minska, och de flesta använde föräldrarapporter. Den granskar hur forskare undersöker detta, inte vad som fungerar, och gäller inte lika för alla. Om ni oroar er för självskada, kontakta en läkare, vården eller en kristjänst; vid akut fara, ring det nationella nödnumret i ert land.

This was a study with autistic adults from the Netherlands Autism Register, who answered questions about suicidal thoughts; 80% had had thoughts of suicide or attempts at least once in their lifetime. It shows associations, not causes, and cannot predict what any one person will experience. If you are worried about someone, seek professional help: a clinician, a health service or a crisis service. In immediate danger, call the emergency number of your country.
